description: Rules pertaining to when a letter of madd comes before a sukūn. There are two types of sukūn, (1) permanent and (2) temporary. A permanent sukūn remains during waqf and waṣl while a temporary sukūn is only made in waqf.

madd_lazim.title: Madd Lāzim
madd_lazim.description: All of the qurra will only apply ṭūl on madd lāzim. Madd lāzim occurs when a letter of madd is followed by a permanent sukūn.

madd_arid_li_sukoon.title: Qaṣr/Tawassuṭ/Ṭūl on madd ʿāriḍ li sukūn/ʿāriḍ waqfī
madd_arid_li_sukoon.description: All of the qurra allow the options of qaṣr, tawassuṭ or ṭūl on ʿāriḍ li sukūn. Madd ʿāriḍ li sukūn (also known as ʿāriḍ waqfī)  occurs when a letter of madd is followed by a temporary sukūn

examples.verse: examples of madd arid li sukoon
